name: Hotel Cappella
beschreibung: The Natura Vitalis Hotel Cappella is a charming, family-run four-star nature wellness hotel located in the picturesque district of Neder at Außerrain 6 in Neustift im Stubaital. Hosts Sonja and Martin Eberharter place passionate emphasis on sustainability and mindful living, which shines through in the warm guest rooms and suites crafted from fragrant local stone pine and natural timber. Modern en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing unobstructed views of the Stubai Alps complete the accommodation. A culinary highlight is the vitality-focused cuisine: certified herbal expert Sonja Eberharter enhances seasonal regional dinners using herbs harvested fresh from her own show garden. The serene spa haven featuring a Finnish herbal sauna, steam room, and relaxation lounge ensures deeply restorative rejuvenation. Complimentary ski buses stop nearby for swift connections to the Stubai Glacier and Schlick 2000, while summer brings endless hiking trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star nature wellness hotel in Neder in Neustift im Stubaital with herbal cuisine, spa oasis, and views of the Stubai Alps.
